CustomField.description: Sum of "Yes" answers across all 20 Campbell DA questions. Unanswered, Unknown, Declined, and N/A questions do not contribute to the score. The unweighted Campbell DA-20 score is the count of Yes answers.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Q01_Violence_Increased__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q02_Owns_Gun__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q03_You_Left__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q04_Unemployed__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q05_Weapon_Threatened__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q06_Threatens_To_Kill__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q07_Avoided_Arrest__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q08_Child_Not_Partners__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q09_Forced_Sex__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q10_Strangled__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q11_Illegal_Drugs__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q12_Alcoholic__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q13_Controls_Daily__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q14_Jealous__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q15_Beaten_Pregnant__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q16_Partner_Suicide__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q17_Threatens_Children__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q18_Capable_Of_Killing__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q19_Stalking__c, "Yes"), 1, 0) + IF(ISPICKVAL(Q20_Your_Suicide__c, "Yes"), 1, 0)
